svg.aria-label: Potentiostatic polarization: after 10 mV is applied, the current decays from the initial value I0 to the steady state Iss. When it changes by less than about 1% over 30 to 60 minutes, average the last stretch. I0 can be taken as the current at the start of the curve, or calculated as ΔV divided by the sum of bulk and interfacial resistance.
